A_continuous_pressure_monitoring.description: Continuous CSF-venous pressure differential monitoring with predictive occlusion algorithm
A_continuous_pressure_monitoring.cerevasc_existing_IP: EP3212275A1 — patency verification via contrast agent + imaging (different mechanism)

B_closed_loop_flow_regulation.description: Active flow control system that adjusts CSF drainage based on pressure/flow feedback
B_closed_loop_flow_regulation.cerevasc_existing_IP: US8672871B2 — passive valve (one-way valve, fixed opening pressure)

C_eshunt_retrieval_rescue.description: System for removing, repositioning, or rescuing a deployed eShunt implant
C_eshunt_retrieval_rescue.cerevasc_existing_IP: US10307577B2 — delivery system only, no retrieval claims

D_occlusion_prevention.description: Structural or chemical design to prevent shunt occlusion (distinct from US20260224866A1 arachnoid pinning)
D_occlusion_prevention.cerevasc_existing_IP: US9861799B2 — anti-occlusion coating; US20260224866A1 — arachnoid pinning

E_CNS_drug_delivery.description: Drug delivery through eShunt anatomy to CSF/subarachnoid space (blood-brain barrier bypass)
E_CNS_drug_delivery.cerevasc_existing_IP: CereVasc website mentions follow-on products for therapy delivery across BBB

A_continuous_pressure_monitoring.evidence: CereVasc has EP3212275A1 (contrast agent patency). 103 risk UNCERTAIN. Competitor space DENSE (90,000+ pressure sensor patents).

B_closed_loop_flow_regulation.evidence: CereVasc has PASSIVE one-way valve (US8672871B2). NO active flow regulation. Competitors have programmable VP shunts but NOT endovascular. Large gap.

C_eshunt_retrieval_rescue.evidence: CereVasc has delivery system (US10307577B2) but ZERO retrieval claims. If eShunt fails, there is no removal method. Clinical urgency HIGH.

D_occlusion_prevention.evidence: CereVasc already has 2 occlusion-prevention patents (US9861799B2 coating + US20260224866A1 arachnoid pinning). Gap is SMALL.

E_CNS_drug_delivery.evidence: CereVasc website mentions follow-on products for therapy delivery across BBB. NO drug delivery patents in 147-portfolio. Large gap. But high technical/regulatory complexity.
